title: OpenBook QR Score Badge
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Build and read an OpenBook QR Score badge, the total out of 100 reported with its quality and reusability halves, and save the badge as a PNG.

learningObjectives: The learner will write the OpenBook QR Score for a resource, in the form QR total (Q quality / R reusability), from ten metric scores, and name which half and which metric hold the total down.
prerequisites: The terms quality subtotal, reusability subtotal, total score, and OpenBook QR Score

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore examples, then build a target and read the feedback
keyQuestions: What are the three numbers in an OpenBook QR Score?
Which half holds the total down?
Is any metric below the floor of 5?
commonMisconceptions: The total alone is enough to report a result
Two resources with the same total need the same fix
A high total means every metric is acceptable
assessmentOpportunities: Write the OpenBook QR Score for a quality subtotal of 32 and a reusability subtotal of 33.
Two resources both total 65. Which is held back by reuse, Q 44 / R 21 or Q 32 / R 33?
What does a dashed module with a ! mean on the badge?

controls.name: Example resource menu
controls.description: loads one of six illustrative resources

controls.name: Ten sliders
controls.description: set each metric score from 0 to 10 in whole points

controls.name: Show scores on badge
controls.description: shows or hides the number on each module

controls.name: Save badge PNG
controls.description: downloads the badge as an image

controls.name: Build challenge
controls.description: switches to three target badges to build and check
